v1.description: Stops a reading that is still going. A parse that has not finished is dropped: the daemon is told, without waiting for its answer, and the job record is marked failed, for the sweep to remove later with its staging folder. The folder is wiped here only when no job record names it. A parse that has already been read in stops the model call instead, and the Markdown that call was consuming is removed so a later try starts clean. Fired by the submitter through POST <submission>.stopProcessing.json.
